description: This file defines the Presenter class responsible for managing UI state and interactions in a window management viewer, including handling trace data, filters, tree generation, and user options.

classes.name: Presenter
classes.description: Manages UI state, trace data, filters, and user options for window management visualization.

methods.name: constructor
methods.description: Initializes the Presenter with trace data, storage, and a callback for UI updates.

methods.name: updatePinnedItems
methods.description: Adds or removes a pinned item and updates the UI.

methods.name: updateHighlightedItems
methods.description: Highlights or unhighlights an item and updates the UI.

methods.name: updateHierarchyTree
methods.description: Updates hierarchy view options and regenerates the tree.

methods.name: filterHierarchyTree
methods.description: Applies a filter to the hierarchy tree.

methods.name: updatePropertiesTree
methods.description: Updates properties view options and refreshes the properties UI.

methods.name: filterPropertiesTree
methods.description: Applies a filter to the properties tree.

methods.name: newPropertiesTree
methods.description: Sets a new selected hierarchy tree and updates the properties UI.

methods.name: onTracePositionUpdate
methods.description: Handles updates to trace position, updating UI data accordingly.

methods.name: generateRects
methods.description: Generates display and window rectangles for UI visualization.

methods.name: updateSelectedTreeUiData
methods.description: Updates UI data for the selected properties tree.

methods.name: generateTree
methods.description: Generates the hierarchy tree based on current filters and options.

methods.name: rectsToUiData
methods.description: Converts raw rectangle data into UI-friendly Rectangle objects.

methods.name: updatePinnedIds
methods.description: Adds or removes an ID from the list of pinned IDs.

methods.name: getTreeWithTransformedProperties
methods.description: Transforms the properties tree with current options and diff settings.
